subject.why: Clear two-storey frontier store with false front, porch awning, boardwalk, and apple barrel.

category.why: Stands firmly on a wide ground plane with an appropriate desert mesa backdrop.

clean.why: No text, UI elements, characters, or borders present.

framing.why: Solid central silhouette with balanced margins around the building.

colour.why: Warm, sunny palette with strong contrast against the blue sky.

detail.why: Clean stylized forms without distracting micro-textures or visual clutter.

style.why: Smooth, chunky 3D forms and satin surfaces matching the reference aesthetic.
